identificationModule.briefTitle: Effect of Trilaciclib in the Prevention of Myelosupression in Subjects With Limited-stage Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicentre Trial Comparing Efficacy and Safety of Trilaciclib Versus Placebo in Participants With Limited-stage Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to compare the efficacy and safety of trilaciclib versus placebo in subjects with limited stage small cell lung cancer. The main question it aims to answer is:

Does trilaciclib have a myeloprotective effect in subject with limited stage small cell lung cancer?

Participants will be randomised to receive either trilaciclib or placebo.

conditions: Limited Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer

primaryOutcomes.measure: To Compare trilaciclib to placebo on prevention of myelosuppression
primaryOutcomes.description: Duration and occurrence of severe neutropenia

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of all-cause chemotherapy dose reductions
Occurrence of granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) administration
Number of hospitalizations due to myelosuppression or sepsis
Occurrence of red blood cell (RBC) transfusions

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed diagnosis of Limited-Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer
* Complete recovery from prior anti-tumor surgical procedures
* Measurable and evaluable disease through tumor assessment
* Willingness to participate and sign informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Extensive Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer
* Active cardiovascular disease
* Known hypersensitivity to trilaciclib, etoposide, carboplatin, cisplatin or any component in their formulations
* Pregnant or nursing women
